name: Mysterious Robed Figure
description: A high-ranking member of the Cog and Key, their face hidden beneath a brass mask.

initial_greeting.text: *mechanical voice* So. A detective has penetrated our sanctum. Impressive. But you're too late. Project Overthrow begins at midnight. Gearhaven will be ours.

defiance.text: You're alone against an organization that controls everything. But I admire your courage. It will make your defeat all the more tragic. Guards! Seize the detective!

explanation.text: He discovered our plans. We offered him a place in the new order—he refused. Such idealism is admirable but foolish. His clockwork designs would have been useful, but we'll manage without them. Now, you'll join him in death.
